sources.quote: Norfolk Southern had one of the lowest accident rates in 2013 and now has the second highest behind Union Pacific, which averaged 4.359 collisions per million miles last year.
sources.searcher_note: Compares Class I railroads on FRA accident rates, not NRC hotline calls; here Union Pacific ranks worst, the opposite ordering from the lead's call counts.

notes: No source found that counts National Response Center reports by railroad or compares CSX/Norfolk Southern call volumes with Union Pacific/BNSF. Press comparisons of the big four use FRA accident rates (E&E News 2023: UP highest, NS second, BNSF falling) or FRA enforcement counts (search results only, not opened: a People's World piece titled 'Two freight railroads account for half of industry safety problems'), which are different measures. The FRA eLibrary page 'National Response Center (NRC) Railroad Report' exists but returned 403 to WebFetch and curl, so its contents are unknown. No coverage dated after 2026-06-30 on this measure; UP-NS merger coverage from 2026 discusses FRA violations, not NRC calls.
